estimands.bev: exact sample and box identity; GT range span <= 1e-9 m, zero relative tolerance, identical range bin and inclusive 80 m cutoff classification; common valid objects averaged within frame, frames within scene; all five fixed GT range bins
estimands.bootstrap: 5000 paired scene resamples; SHA256 counter indices; seed 20260831; confidence 0.95
estimands.eligibility: operator validity, independent of global row validity; absent support is null with reason; missing expected source inventory is fatal
estimands.pixel: mean of per-frame P50/P90, then mean across scenes; each frame quantile uses its own within-row valid point errors; no cross-method point pairing
estimands.pose: signed bias descriptors retained; absolute per-axis errors used for improvement; translation converted from metres to centimetres
estimands.recovery: joint geodesic <=0.25 degrees and translation norm <=5 cm; rate percent, improvement percentage points
estimands.sampling_unit: scene; equal scene weights; equal matched-frame weights within scene
estimands.seeds: report 17/42/73 separately; fixed-three-seed mean uses common eligible support across baseline and all three seeds; interval conditional on those fixed seeds, not training randomness
estimands.timing: identity stress only; no timing correction rows or correction denominators
